'''Ben Krissle''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] individual who lived on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] during the early days of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. Krissle was a known [[Gambling/Legends|card cheat]] who was mentioned while older locals were trying to identify an individual named Ben. They also mentioned [[Ben Gaddink]], [[Ben Moordriver]], and [[Ben Surrep]].<ref name="Kenobi">''[[Kenobi (novel)|Kenobi]]</ref>
